name: Rath Chinneich

attributes.attribute: location of the mythological palace of Nemed
never found, thought to be in County Armagh
one of the first settlers of Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rath Chinneich is an Irish mythological site. Tradition set the dwelling of Nemed, an early settler of Ireland, at this place. The site has never been found, though it is thought to lie in County Armagh.

okr.objective: Rath Chinneich is the lost site of the palace of Nemed.
key_results: Rath Chinneich held the mythological palace of Nemed.
Nemed was one of the first settlers of Ireland.
The site has never been found.
It is thought to lie in County Armagh.
